features: Expanded Listen Together to support multi-app sync networks (SonicSpace Hub, Metrolist Network, EchoMusic Sync, BitChord Network, and Custom Server) with flexible room code sizes and custom endpoints.
Combined About and App Updates into one page, preserving About order and using compact grouped update controls.
Removed the Apple Music tab from Search and redesigned Explore as a single categorized discovery feed.
Added a screen-owned Your Replay app bar and consistent content spacing to listening stats.
Redesigned About screen with a compact app identity header and native grouped project information.
Restyled Library device shortcuts as full-width link rows and removed duplicate built-in playlists from the Playlists shelf.
Added backdrop blur to the main top app bar when Liquid Glass is enabled.
Updated navigation and playback icons with SpatialFlow vector drawables.
Restyled History and album songs to match Home's unboxed track rows.
Moved artist-only recommendations below song suggestions on Home.
Reduced the main top app bar height by 5 dp.
Removed Listen Together from Home and moved Daily Discover to the top.
Restyled generated Home recommendations as square-card shelves.
Removed AI Hub and System Update from Settings.
Added Daily Discover section below New Releases on the Home screen.
Standardized Library section header font sizes and card sizes to match Home screen.
Redesigned Mood & Genre cards on Search and Explore with duotone color palettes.
Increased TopAppBar logo size by 1.5x and made 'Listen Now' title larger with ExtraBold weight.
Added 'Picked for you' recommendations section at the top of the Home feed.
Promoted Daily Discover and Community Playlists to the top of the Home feed.
Redesigned Explore screen Mood & Genre items with BitChord-inspired duotone image cards.
Added Liked Songs, Your Playlists, and Albums for You sections to Home Screen.
Restyled Picked for You as a two-page compact song shelf with square-cropped cover art.
Changed the YouTube Listen Again shelf to a two-row grid of square artwork cards.
Removed randomized Home section ordering in favor of a stable feed order.
Removed Speed Dial and Mood & Genres sections from Home.
Interactive genre chips now dynamically load genre song suggestions, mixes, and playlists.
Differentiated song title and artist typography with distinct sizes and subtle greyish colors, and added proper vertical row spacing in list views.
Redesigned Explore tab on Search screen with BitChord-inspired responsive grid and duotone category cards.
Added dynamic background artwork loading for Explore mood & genre category cards.
Enlarged app logo on onboarding welcome page and updated ecosystem page icon.
Replaced onboarding illustrations on pages 2-9 with SpatialFlow Apache-2.0 vectors while retaining SonicSpace branding on the Welcome page.
Added parallel concurrent artwork loading for Explore screen and Home screen Mood & Genre items.
Reorganized root documentation into a dedicated docs/ hub and added repository architecture map to README.
Restructured 16 submodules into a clean modules/ directory with dedicated core, features, lyrics, canvas, and providers hierarchy.
Added Navigation Bar Style options (Hide Nav Labels and Dynamic Navbar) with live toggles in Appearance settings.
Added Haptic Feedback Service with customizable vibration intensity and responsive tactile gestures.
Applied SpatialFlow navbar dimensions and scroll-hiding across screens, with root-only tab visibility.
Upgraded dynamic theme with SpatialFlow's harmonic HSL palette generator, AMOLED black integration, and rich album art seed extraction.
Increased navbar height and added elevated floating icon surfaces with custom tonal pill indicator for dynamic navbar mode.
Rewrote all project documentation, guides, policies, and agent instructions from scratch tailored exclusively for SonicSpace.
Removed Commits option from the System Update settings screen.
Elevated app version to 1.5.0 (versionCode 150).
Removed Stats tab from Search screen.
Added smooth sliding selection chip animation across navbar tabs when changing screens.
Redesigned settings options into compact grouped cards with sleek vertical padding and inner dividers.

Added multi-source high-quality audio: JioSaavn 320 kbps and user-configurable addon server (Tidal/Qobuz/Deezer/Apple Music) are tried before YouTube, with four quality tiers — Lossless, High (320 kbps), Opus, and YouTube Only.
Added 'Show Player Option Chips' setting toggle in Player Settings to control option chips visibility.
Added 'Comments' option chip to the player action chips row.
Implemented the BitChord color palette in Onboarding by default with reactive theme switching and BitChord palette preference toggle.
Streamlined Theme Settings palette controls with a clean toggle between BitChord Palette and Dynamic Theme Palette (wallpaper & live album art extraction).
Automatically enabled iOS style floating nav bar when switching to BitChord Palette, and restricted Home screen top gradient background to Dynamic Theme only.
Upgraded Dynamic Theme to use Google Material Color Utilities (Quantizer & CorePalette via MaterialKolor Expressive) for full Material 3 dynamic color generation from album artwork.
Integrated ArchiveTune-inspired theme engine with animateColorScheme for smooth live color transitions across the entire app UI without affecting BitChord Palette.

Unified active song row styling with primary dynamic theme accents across title, subtitle, badges, icons, and playing indicators, removed top gradient overlay box from Home screen, and restored untinted original app logo on TopAppBar.
Removed Play All buttons from Home screen headers and removed border from the floating navbar page selecting chip.
Redesigned main Settings screen into compact grouped cards with an integrated Account Profile card and live search bar, omitting category section headers.

Restructured Appearance settings so Group 1 includes App Icon, Theme, and Liquid Glass, moved Enable Dynamic Theme inside Theme Screen, and added a dedicated Misc settings group for High Refresh Rate and Disable Screenshots.
Cleaned up Appearance settings by removing redundant lyrics options and turning off/removing Auto Playlists settings group by default.
Cleaned up Appearance settings by removing miniplayer swipe sensitivity option from the player group, removing the Auto Playlists settings group, and merging both Misc groups into a single group.
Elevated app version to 1.6.0 (versionCode 160).
bug_fixes: Fixed faded top app bar action icons (Settings, History, Listen Together) in BitChord palette and dynamic theme by tinting with full-contrast onSurface color.
Fixed video songs still appearing on Home feed, search results, and playlists when 'Hide Video Songs' is enabled by passing musicVideoType and enforcing strict section filtering.
Adjusted settings group spacing: increased spacing between group title/header and options card while compacting spacing between adjacent settings groups.
Added ProGuard/R8 rules for InnerTube models, playback serializers, and Media3/ExoPlayer components to resolve release build playback failures.
Fixed mini player scroll translation in dynamic navbar mode so it remains docked at the bottom of the screen instead of disappearing off-screen.
Redesigned Queue screen on Liquid Glass with unboxed song rows and clean swipe-to-dismiss behavior.
Debounced FloatingTabBar scroll connection sensitivity and prevented accidental player sheet expansion during scroll-up gestures.
Fixed unresolved WindowInsets.only reference in StatsScreen.
Matched local History date banner color to remote History.
Fixed dynamic navigation bar bottom gap by extending container surface to the screen edge.
Fixed syntax error in LibraryMixScreen.kt.
Fixed unresolved reference error for aspectRatio in HomeScreen.kt.
Adjusted category chip row spacing and faded borders for a cleaner Home screen layout.
Removed legacy Nothing OS branding references across all documentation and project files.
Cleaned up README.md by removing emojis and the build/setup section.
Fixed ChangelogSection type mismatch compilation error in ChangelogScreen.
Removed redundant update cards and 'What's New' sections from Settings and Update Settings screens.
Fixed heightIn and maxWidth compilation errors in HomeScreen.kt.
Removed corrupted prompt artifacts from SECURITY.md and updated doc paths across AGENT.md.
Fixed faded and low-contrast colors across all Onboarding setup screens in Light Mode.
Fixed Onboarding navigation style and haptic intensity preferences not syncing to app DataStore.
Fixed dynamic navbar proportions and label layout to prevent cramped text overlap when labels are enabled.
Updated build configuration to produce universal release APKs named SonicSpace-gms.apk and SonicSpace-foss.apk.
Added SonicSpace header banner image to README.md.
Updated default theme palette to a darker sapphire blue tone and increased liquid glass surface opacity for reduced background transparency.
Added direct toggles to enable or disable the Liquid Glass blur effect in Appearance and Theme settings.
Fixed LocalListenTogetherManager type argument mismatch compilation error under Kotlin 2.3 compiler.

Fixed YouTube account login crashes by adding null-safe response parsing for AccountMenuResponse, fixing background thread state mutations in LoginScreen WebView callbacks, preventing force-kill runtime exit, and saving authentication cookies in Onboarding login.
Fixed playlist playback selection issue where selecting a song played a different track down the list by scoping HideVideoSongs filtering exclusively to Home Screen and preventing queue index shifts.
Fixed Dynamic Theme activation check in MainActivity so dynamic theme colors seamlessly apply when enabled in Settings and when music plays.
